build_filter_similar_class: build a FilterSimilarClass instance with CONFIG dict containing DATA_DIR, QUESTION_IDX, CLUSTER_DIR, COSINE_DISTANCES, and COSINE_KNNS keys
run_calculate_similarity: run calculate_similarity to compute a SequenceMatcher ratio between two question strings
run_remove_symbolic_differences: run remove_symbolic_differences to filter out questions above a similarity threshold from a cluster list
run_find_cosine_based_similar: run find_cosine_based_similar to remove half of cosine-similar questions from a dataset map using KNN clusters
run_get_clusters: run get_clusters to load an HDF5 distance file and return similar point indices using KDE thresholding
